description: MtaStsEnforcer holds its policy cache in a HashMap inside an Arc<Mutex<...>>. On process restart the cache is empty and every outbound delivery attempt for every domain requires a fresh DNS lookup + HTTPS policy fetch. Under MTA-STS enforce mode, if the policy server is unreachable at restart time, all outbound delivery to that domain will fail (fail-closed per RFC 8461) until the cache warms. Fix: persist the cache to a file or SQLite table on shutdown and reload on startup to avoid cold-start delivery failures.
title: smtp: MTA-STS cache not persisted across process restarts
